notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR2 runs a file-name section after OPEN, CLOSE, DELETE and START, and after a READ "(after any other specified USE procedure) not resulting in the execution of an associated AT END or INVALID KEY imperative statement". DebugTriggerPlanner.PlanFile plans those five verbs only; the READ emitters land the fire after the NOT phrases (LandAfterActionKeeping) and on the no-record arm without AT END/INVALID KEY (LandFileNameAfterFailure, spaces), and KeyedIoEmitter.EmitDelete/EmitStart land it after the USE procedure and INVALID KEY; the witness covers sequential and relative files. Probes at 85 (dbg/g2a, g2b, g2c): sequential, indexed and relative files, OPEN/CLOSE fire, WRITE/REWRITE do not, READ fires with the record (variable-length 3-of-8 record gives "XYZ" + spaces), READ AT END and READ INVALID KEY taken do not fire, READ past EOF with no AT END fires after the USE procedure (status 46), READ of a closed file fires after U-SEC 47, failed START/DELETE with INVALID KEY fire after it, failed OPEN (35) fires after the USE procedure; READ WITH NO LOCK and DELETE FILE are refused at 85 (COBOL0900).

next.reason: 1985: "When file-name-1 is specified in a USE FOR DEBUGGING statement, that debugging section is executed"; 2023: "No candidate states USE FOR DEBUGGING; the 2023 USE rules cover only exception, report and object declaratives.". 2023 lacks USE FOR DEBUGGING and its debugging sections. No candidate covers a debugging section run after OPEN, CLOSE, READ, DELETE or START.
